snippet.title: Chromatic Dragon Pattern Perception Trailer
snippet.description:
Chromatic Dragon Pattern Perception is a game of remembering and repeating patterns. How many can you get in a row?

Check out the game on the following sites:
itch.io: https://dragonsisle.itch.io/chromatic-dragon-pattern-perception
Crazy Games: https://www.crazygames.com/game/chromatic-dragon-pattern-perception
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dragonsisle.chromatic_dragon_pattern_perception
